0022600195.text: The Trail Blazers host the San Antonio Spurs in Portland's ninth game of the season. Portland enters at 6-1, first in the Northwest and first in the West, on a three-game win streak and 5-0 on the road, while San Antonio is 6-2 on a six-game streak and sits sixth in the West, second in the Southwest and 0.5 games back. Portland is missing Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery) and Vit Krejci (ankle), and San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The teams have not played yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Trail Blazers lost the regular-season series 1-2 and the playoff series 1-4, with the most recent meeting a 114-95 playoff loss in San Antonio on April 28, 2026.
